summary: Frontend Coding Agent implemented the full NFR-REL-001 (Auto-Save Crash Durability) production code on branch feature/18-nfr-rel-001-frontend-tests. All 6 production modules created: dbSchema.ts (IndexedDB schema with idb library), persistenceService.ts (atomic dual-store writes, closeSession, quota purge), crashRecoveryService.ts (boot-time crash detection with validation and purge), persistenceStore.ts (Zustand store bridging scene state to IndexedDB), useAutoSave.ts (interval + beforeunload hook), ResumePrompt.tsx (accessible modal with data-testid attributes). Dependencies added: idb (production), fake-indexeddb (devDependency). Implementation satisfies all 10 test cases from the TDD suite.

artifacts.name: dbSchema.ts
artifacts.description: IndexedDB schema definition with idb library wrapper, types for SceneSnapshot and AutoSaveMeta, DB opener with upgrade logic

artifacts.name: persistenceService.ts
artifacts.description: Atomic dual-store writes (saveSnapshot), closeSession, loadSnapshot, purgeSession, purgeOldSnapshots, PersistenceError class

artifacts.name: crashRecoveryService.ts
artifacts.description: Boot-time crash detection (detectCrash), snapshot validation, acceptRecovery, discardRecovery

artifacts.name: persistenceStore.ts
artifacts.description: Zustand store with triggerAutoSave, markSessionClosed, checkForCrashRecovery, resumeSession, discardSession

artifacts.name: useAutoSave.ts
artifacts.description: React hook with interval-based auto-save and beforeunload listener, overlap guard, cleanup on unmount

artifacts.name: ResumePrompt.tsx
artifacts.description: Accessible modal dialog with role=dialog, aria-modal, data-testid attributes, Resume/Discard buttons
